notes.title: OLGA Featured on 24indie
notes.content:
📰 [b]Early Bird Press[/b]

We're excited to share that OLGA: Episode 1 was just featured on 24indie.com !
This heartfelt article dives into the pixel-perfect world of OLGA, highlighting its blend of melancholic storytelling, Slavic culture, and cozy point-and-click adventure.

🪆 Take a stroll through memory, mystery, and mushrooms — and see what makes OLGA such a unique journey into the past.

📖 Read the full feature here:
👉 [url=https://24indie.com/olga-episode-1-stroll-through-slavic-nostalgia/]https://24indie.com/olga-episode-1-stroll-through-slavic-nostalgia/[/url]

Big thanks to 24indie for the thoughtful write-up — and to our players for supporting indie storytelling with heart.
